title: QI-Bench-Pareto: Many-Objective Optimisation of Global Quantum Internet Topologies
description: Reproducibility package (code, data and results) for the article 'Many-Objective Optimisation of Global Quantum Internet Topologies: A Compact Parametric Representation with an Analytical BDCZ Oracle', accepted for publication in Entropy (MDPI), 2026. Contains the analytical BDCZ oracle, the 11-variable parametric decoder, all experiment scripts, the pooled seven-algorithm non-dominated front (561 unique objective vectors, 944 structurally distinct topologies, with per-point algorithm/seed provenance), the JSON results behind every table and figure, and the figure-generation code. Code is MIT-licensed (LICENSE-CODE); data (cities.csv, results/) is CC-BY-4.0 (LICENSE-DATA).
